column4: Clauses 1-3 of the sentence (every nonzero idempotent is infinite; eRe contains s,t with ts=e/=st; eRe is simple, so e-st generates eRe as a two-sided ideal) are unconditional in Algebra/PurelyInfiniteSimpleRingIdempotents.lean. The final clause (EL_m(eRe) kills MF targets) stays with the existing carrier MFQuotientUnitsSentences.manuscriptSentence_cornerElementaryKillsMFTargets, conditional on thm:full-defect-ring rank two.

Item (a), whole sentence, both halves. printedItemA is the closed existential package: for every purely infinite simple ring and every m >= 4 there are orthogonal idempotents summing to 1, pairwise equivalent apart from the last, the last equivalent to an idempotent f <= e_1, such that R is the twisted matrix ring over T = e_1Re_1 with identity diag(1_T,...,1_T,f) and last column in Tf, last row in fT, AND every unit factors as u = g v h with g and h in the subgroup generated by the elementary matrices e_ij(x) and v = e_1 + (1-e_1)v(1-e_1). f is a genuine copy of the last block inside e_1, not e_1 itself. The factorisation clause is also available on its own at ANY decomposition meeting item (a)'s hypotheses, as printedItemAShape; the matrix clause likewise, as printedTwistedPeirceMatrixRing. The printed m >= 4 is carried in both packages.
